title: PAR-20/7G.3 MATERIAL key and OBJECTS identity closure
scope: Audit generated MATERIAL output for exact root/dictionary edges and section-wide handle identity.
Require one NOD ACAD_MATERIAL key, the exact Paint key to remapped MATERIAL handle, an owner-0 NOD, and unique OBJECTS handles.
Reuse the current ASCII/Binary material capture selector without persistent fixture or test registration.

sourceChange.change: The MATERIAL output round-trip now counts ACAD_MATERIAL root keys, verifies the one Paint dictionary entry targets the remapped typed MATERIAL handle, and checks owner-0 NOD identity plus unique nonempty OBJECTS handles.
sourceChange.reason: Previous output checks verified dictionary entry count and owner but did not prove the dictionary key resolved to the emitted MATERIAL; root lookup was presence-only and the OBJECTS scan did not verify section-wide uniqueness.
